# Allowlist of SPDX license identifiers that are considered acceptable for this workspace.
# The license audit (`license-checker`) fails the build when a dependency reports a
# license that is not listed here. Add entries only after reviewing the license
# terms and documenting the reason in a comment on the same line.
#
# Format: one license identifier per line. Matching is case-insensitive and
	# substring-based against the license string reported by license-checker.
# Empty lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.

Unlicense
UNLICENSED

PSLF
BSL-1.0
WTFPL
zlib
